scene_description: A classroom scene showing a smiling female teacher standing in front of a green chalkboard with math problems written on it. Several children are seated at desks with their hands raised eagerly. The teacher appears to be leading a lesson.

questions.question: Where are the children and teacher?
questions.evidence_hint: Look at the chalkboard and the desks around the room.

questions.question: What is the chalkboard used for in school?
questions.evidence_hint: Look at what is written on the big green board behind the teacher.

questions.question: What might the teacher do next when she sees all the raised hands?
